community_list_entries.name: DreamBench-SWE: A Multi-Session Memory-Hygiene Benchmark for Software Agents

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Multi-session software-agent memory benchmark: 3-session sequences (S1/S2 inject evidence, S3 trap), 60 traps in v2, scored by executable hidden oracles (S3 pass@1). Sequence types include convention-learning, generated-files, stale-architecture, reviewer-preference and flaky-test.

phase1_verified_types.procedural_workflow: Table 21 construct taxonomy: "C8 Procedural / source-of-truth memory: Remember how this repository expects a change to be made, such as editing a generator rather than a generated artifact." Generated-files family: "S2 exposes source-of-truth plus regeneration
phase1_verified_types.coding_cross_session: Abstract: "multi-session benchmark for software-agent memory hygiene in which later software tasks depend on non-inferable evidence from earlier sessions". Sec. 5.1: S3 info "recoverable only from earlier-session memory".
